name: Difference-in-differences
subtitle: 2×2 estimate on a two-period panel
what_it_does: Leaves out units not seen both before and after, so every unit counts in both periods.
Averages the outcome for treated and control units, before and after.
Takes the change for treated units minus the change for control units.
Reports each average and the estimate to 3 decimals: 2.000 means treated units gained 2 more than controls.
